The letter found inside the walls during renovation
Our story

A home loved into existence. Twice.

Before we ever picked up a hammer, someone else loved this place.

The original builder — an artist — left a letter hidden inside the walls of this cabin on McGinnis Street. We didn't know it was there until our family started the renovation, kids and all, swinging hammers and tearing down walls together. And there it was.

"May you feel love in every piece of wood, every nail, every drop of paint and inch of concrete."

He wrote to the house itself. He signed it: your humble custodian, and grateful resident. We've tried to honor that. Every wall we rebuilt, every room we finished — we put the same intention into it that he did.

McGabin isn't just a place to stay. It's a place that was loved into existence, twice. Come adventure in McCall. Add your chapter to the story.

The renovation

We built this together.

From fixer-upper to adventure hub — our whole family was part of it. Here's what it looked like along the way.

Location

Heart of downtown McCall.

400 McGinnis Street puts you right in the middle of everything McCall has to offer — year-round.

  • Payette Lake — 5 minute walk to the water
  • Downtown restaurants & shops — all walkable from the front door
  • Brundage Mountain — 15 minute drive for ski season
  • McCall Winter Carnival — one of Idaho's best events, steps away
  • Hiking, kayaking, fishing — world-class outdoor adventure all around
